as_told.title: Matthew Brown's tweet: White House has a proprietary AI that predicts future timelines

plain: The White House is said to have "long possessed a unique AI capable of accurately predicting a range of future events," in the words of a tweet that Matthew Brown, introduced on the show as a Pentagon whistleblower, sent to the businessman Elon Musk. On another episode Michels repeats it from memory, calling it "the weirdest" tweet and describing it as a crystal ball that predicts future timelines. If true, the government would have a secret tool for seeing what comes next.
